source: Gemeente Rotterdam tree register, layer SB_Infra/Bomen/0
_extent_note: n_trees counts every tree in the query bounding box, which is larger than the buurten. Density and canopy cover live in `per_buurt` and `combined`, where the numerator and denominator share one polygon.

canopy._note: cover_fraction is measured inside the buurten. Crowns are modelled as circles of diameter KROONOMVANG and overlaps are counted twice, so it is an upper bound. total_m2_bounding_box covers the larger query box and must not be divided by the buurt area.
